title: Careers
intro: Undergraduate and graduate students from all majors can join CalPlug and Calit2 research projects for 199/299 course credit. Projects tackle real industry and societal problems and usually span at least two UCI schools.
deadline: Applications are due by 5:00 pm PT on Friday of Week 1 of each quarter, the course registration deadline. Spring 2026 deadline: April 3, 2026.
offer: Mentorship from faculty and project leaders
1–3 course credits (199/299); possible paid positions after 2+ quarters of outstanding work
ask: GPA 3.0+ preferred; lower GPAs considered with an explanation
At least 3 quarters (one year) of research
At least 8 hours a week (2 units)
Team meetings, a research log, and a short report each quarter

positions.title: AI & Energy Efficiency
positions.description: Apply AI and machine learning to predict and control the performance of thermal energy systems.
tasks: Generate high-fidelity thermal datasets with CFD and transient thermal simulation
Select and train ML models validated with FE data
Build AI applications for TES systems of different scales and conditions

positions.title: Energy Engineering
positions.description: Join a DOE-funded program that gives free energy assessments to small and medium-sized manufacturers.
tasks: Train as an energy efficiency engineer
Learn how to reduce waste and improve productivity

link.label: SMART Industrial Training and Assessment Program

positions.title: Electrical Engineering & AI-driven Management
positions.description: Explore cost-effective retrofit strategies that make edge data centers more energy efficient.
tasks: Measure the energy use of IT server loads and cooling loads in server rooms
Develop AI algorithms for real-time data center load management
Monitor and analyze energy data at the Calit2 facility across demonstration phases

positions.title: Building Automation & Remote Sensing and Control
positions.description: Develop whole-building load management for lighting, HVAC and plug load devices.
tasks: Develop AI load prediction for real-time control of lighting and HVAC
Demonstrate the technology at a campus site and measure energy savings

apply.title: Contact a mentor
apply.text: Read the positions and email the mentor to learn more about the project.

apply.title: Apply by Week 1
apply.text: New and returning students apply by 5:00 pm PT on Friday of Week 1. With the Dean's approval, applications may be accepted until Week 3.

apply.title: Interview
apply.text: Selected students are invited to an interview, in person or online, about skills, interests and availability.

apply.title: Enroll
apply.text: Once matched with a project, submit the 199/299 paperwork.
